definition: to move lower but not to the bottom
description: A young woman with a long braid, a red helmet, a red vest top, black shorts and hiking boots abseils down the wet cliff face of a deep, narrow rock canyon, with ferns on the walls and a waterfall pouring down in a misty beam of light behind. She sits back in her harness with her feet against the rock and holds the rope with gloved hands as she moves lower step by step. As she goes down, a pool of water with round stones comes into view at the bottom of the canyon.

taps.phrase: to lean back in her harness
